CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linking to identified content present.

COD.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content (red at p1/current/n3), provides an origin/status entry for that node, and gives layout/organizational information; these jointly satisfy C, O and D for the same referent/time under model_organization.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement linking to a specific content's organization or access.

C.rationale: The text explicitly lists represented content (red) with coordinate set for a current node.

D.rationale: The report separately records an origin/status entry for the same node, distinguishing content identity from its provenance/status.

O.rationale: The report indicates how content is organized/presented via node origin metadata and an explicit coordinate layout statement.
